title: Regrouping a compact filtered presentation along a colimit-preserving functor
statement:
Use universes, smallness, regular cardinals, filteredness, compactness, coherent diagrams and colimits from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa$ be an uncountable regular cardinal in the smaller universe. Let $\mathcal E,\mathcal F$ be locally small infinity categories admitting all small colimits, and let $H:\mathcal E\to\mathcal F$ preserve all small colimits. Let $\mathcal P\subseteq\mathcal F$ be a full subcategory closed under equivalence, consisting of $\kappa$-compact objects and closed under $\kappa$-small colimits computed in $\mathcal F$. Let $A$ be a small $\kappa$-filtered partially ordered set and $q:N(A)\to\mathcal E$ a diagram such that $q(a)$ and $H(q(a))$ are $\kappa$-compact for every $a\in A$. Write $x=\operatorname{colim}_{N(A)}q$. Suppose there is a small $\kappa$-filtered partially ordered set $J$ and a diagram $r:N(J)\to\mathcal P$ with $\operatorname{colim}_{N(J)}r\simeq H(x)$ in $\mathcal F$.

For each subset $b\subseteq A$ of cardinality less than $\kappa$ which is filtered in its inherited order (including nonemptiness), choose a colimiting cocone on $q|_{N(b)}$ with apex $x_b$. Let $B$ be the partially ordered set, ordered by inclusion, of those subsets $b$ for which $H(x_b)\in\mathcal P$. Then $B$ is small and $\kappa$-filtered, and every subset $T\subseteq A$ of cardinality less than $\kappa$ is contained in some $b\in B$. The chosen partial colimit cocones assemble to a coherent diagram $q':N(B)\to\mathcal E$, with $q'(b)=x_b$, and to a compatible colimiting cocone with apex $x$, whose components are induced by the original cocone on $q$. Every $q'(b)$ is $\kappa$-compact and $H(q'(b))\in\mathcal P$.
